channel.title: BBC WoW Campaign
channel.description: Last 10 notes on BBC WoW Campaign

item.title: Sylvanas Windrunner
item.description: Sylvanas Windrunner First Impression A pale ranger-general in dark leather, bow across her back, who speaks quietly and does not blink as often as a living person would.

item.title: The Lich King
item.description: The Lich King In a sentence A figure on a frozen throne at the top of the world, who has not moved in four years, and whose patience is the most frightening thing about him.

item.title: Thrall
item.description: Thrall First Impression A very large orc in plain mail who listens for a long time before speaking, and whose accent is a human nobleman’s — because that’s who raised him.

item.title: Tirion Fordring
item.description: Tirion Fordring First Impression An old man in a farmer’s coat outside a one-room hut, splitting wood.

item.title: Tyrande Whisperwind
item.description: Tyrande Whisperwind In a sentence A tall night elf in silver who has been in charge for four years and has not once been able to consult the person she most wants to.

item.title: Uther the Lightbringer
item.description: Uther the Lightbringer In a sentence A tomb in the middle of a dead country, and a great many people who cannot bring themselves to visit it.

item.title: Varian Wrynn
item.description: Varian Wrynn In a sentence A gap in the record. A throne with nobody on it and no official explanation.

item.title: Vol'jin
item.description: Vol’jin In a sentence A lean troll leaning on a wall in the Valley of Spirits, watching everything, saying very little, and missing nothing.

item.title: Ysera
item.description: Ysera In a sentence The Aspect of Nature, asleep for ten thousand years, dreaming — and the dream has started to go wrong.

item.title: Book of Medivh
item.description: Book of Medivh Appearance A grimoire written by a man who was possessed while he wrote it, and nobody is entirely sure which parts were his.
